_comment: THIS TREE'S OWN IDENTITY — the FROM side of every rebrand. tooling/rebrand/rebrand.mjs reads it to know what to rename AWAY from; a product's identity is the --values file, which is the TO side. Change a value here only together with the tree: these strings must be what the tree actually contains, or the rename silently misses and the product ships carrying this baseline's name. `productName` is the SITE_NAME seam in apps/web/app/site.ts (the page's title; upstream's was a leftover, `Deepgram AI Agent`); `domain` and `subdomain` are placeholders, because this baseline has never deployed under a name of its own; `githubOwner` is the owner in the source links the docs carry. The upstream template's own names DO carry this slug — its repository deepgram-starters/nextjs-live-transcription and its Vercel template page …/nextjslive-transcription — so rebrand.mjs protects them (UPSTREAM), and it allows Deepgram's SDK identifiers LiveTranscriptionEvents/LiveTranscriptionEvent, which spell this slug's Pascal form.
